Evidence Caveats & Self-Improvement

Caveats

  1. cass health degraded (2nd+ week) — Session counts are lower bounds; never run bare cass index.
  2. Silent-success pattern repeated — Two fixes this week (exclusions, openclaw) suggest every connector needs row-count proof, not skipped: 0.
  3. Report automation unwired 4th week — Manual reports paper over the miss; dashboard renders the gap but does not close it.
  4. Career conversion stalled 5th week — Engineering ships weekly; conversion waits on outreach and presence. The trade is the item most needing correction.
  5. LD insertions telemetry-dominated — +5,464 is mostly snapshot data, not authored prose. Do not chart as effort.
  6. Muse sessions unindexed — OpenClaw migration noted; other harnesses per 08-21 remain uncounted.

Self-Improvement

  1. Connector row-count proof — Every indexing report should show resolved / skipped / indexed, per agent. Would have caught openclaw months earlier.
  2. Report freshness metric — Proposed 08-21; run-log warning exists but renders nowhere visible on the face. Add it.
  3. Carry-age promotion validated — 8-week and 5-week items need headline surfacing, not just ledger rows. Tabbed carry-over is the first step.
  4. Evidence gathering — Easy for git / LD / run-log; partial for sessions (stale index + unindexed harnesses). Per-harness normalizer still missing.
  5. Next-week proof gate — If openclaw row counts are zero on next nightly run, the fix is incomplete regardless of commit message.
